prisoners.name: Kyle Frankovich
prisoners.description: Kyle Frankovich is a Harvard University data scientist who was arrested at the Broadview immigration detention facility protest on October 3, 2025. He said he had been observing and filming federal agents from a designated protest area. He was detained and released without charges. Images of him in restraints later appeared in federal recruitment material. In October 2026, he and Maureen Foody sued podcaster Benny Johnson for defamation, alleging that his videos falsely portrayed them as violent attackers.

cases.sentence: No sentence; released without charges. Sources: https://capitolnewsillinois.com/news/15-residents-filed-complaints-against-homeland-security-for-midway-blitz-harms/ ; https://www.wutc.org/2026-10-02/pro-trump-influencer-benny-johnson-is-being-sued-for-defamation-by-ice-protesters ; https://video.kqed.org/video/caught-in-the-crackdown-iuqldg/ Their October 2, 2026 civil complaint states that they were confined for approximately eight hours and released without charges after the October 3, 2025 protest. Source: https://storage.courtlistener.com/recap/gov.uscourts.ilnd.508991/gov.uscourts.ilnd.508991.1.0_1.pdf (Foody v. Johnson, 1:26-cv-12104, paragraphs 34–38).
